Performed Stage-1 backtest using the autoresearch grinder harness, followed by walk-forward OOS test and real-fills confirmation on OP-16 anchor days. The grinder harness did not yield any new candidate that met the edge_capture threshold of 771 (50% of max possible 1542) and passed all pre-merge gates. The current leaderboard remains the best available set of strategies.

The Stage-1 backtest was completed, but the exact number of combinations and passers is not available in this analysis output. For detailed Stage-1 results, see the grinder harness output in `autoresearch/_state/overnight_grinder/progress.json`.

Real-fills confirmation on the 6 OP-16 anchor days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04, 5/05, 5/06, 5/07) was conducted. No candidate achieved edge_capture >= 771 across the anchor days.
